newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates seesaw to end slightly down.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates seesaw to end slightly down.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates fluctuated on Monday to end slightly down at 19.50 percent as the market remained short and banks approached the State (central) Bank of Pakistan for discounting, dealers said.

"The market started at 19.75 percent, but the rates could not stay firm and slid down," a dealer said. "By midday, the rates slipped at the day's low of 17 percent, but later bounced back and closed pegged at 19.50."
"The market closed short yet again and banks were seen approaching the State Bank's discount window for substantial amounts."
Dealers said one-week bids were done between 17 and 19 percent, while two-weeks repos remained mismatched at 16.50 and 18.50 percent.
